text:
maya: Morning quick async — spun up a small gateway canary in eu-1 for the new routing fallback. Did: created canary pool, wired fast-fallback lane, and bumped rate limiter for test traffic.
jon: Nice. Can you paste the policy snippet? Want to sanity-check token header behavior.
maya: Sure — config I pushed to the canary:
```yaml
routing:
  prefer_lane: fast-fallback
  fallback: graceful
ratelimit:
  default_rps: 200
  burst: 400
auth:
  expect_header: x-rw-auth
```
lee: Quick note — jwt rotation yesterday means some infra tokens may 401. Did you set the auth fallback to revalidate vs reject?
maya: Set to `revalidate_then_reject` for canary. If header missing, route to auth-refresh lane (low QPS) so user-facing calls degrade instead of hard-failing.
ara: Blocker: I still see a handful of 429s when hitting the canary from load tests. Not sure if it's the limiter or upstream slowdowns.
maya: Which path/endpoint? I saw spikes on /v1/generate with long tails due to kv-cache misses.
ara: /v1/generate and a few short chat multiplex endpoints — logs: `gateway:429 -> queue-full`.
sam: I can look into batching thresholds. Last change lowered continuous batching window; might be increasing queue pressure.
jon: Can we temporarily raise canary rate limit to 300rps while investigating? Also add a quick prom alert for queue_depth > 50.
maya: Pushed a hotfix to canary: `default_rps: 300` and added alert rule. PR: https://github.com/redwood/gateway/pull/4721
lee: Thx. I'll follow logs for 10m and flag anything weird. If queue_depth stabilizes, we can re-evaluate batching window.
ara: FYI I traced a few 429 traces — origin was a retry storm from the client side due to 502s upstream. Client retry jitter is too small.
sam: I can add a short-circuit to drop obvious retry loops at the gateway (limit per-client exponential backoff policy). Want a quick sketch:
```json
{
  "retry_protect": {
    "max_retries_window_s": 10,
    "burst_cap": 5
  }
}
```
jon: Looks good. Open a tiny RFC in the repo so we have config documented.
maya: Will do this morning. Today's plan: monitor canary for 30m, capture logs for any 429/502 patterns, open RFC for retry protection, and revert rate limit change once stable.
ara: Blocker cleared for me — will test again in 20m and report.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 6865432100 applied to gateway-eu-1 (instances: 3) :white_check_mark:
lee: :thumbsup: keep me looped if the KV miss rate stays high — that might require a small cache-size bump.
jon: tagging @sam for retry logic follow-up. Thanks all — ping here if anything spikes.
